player_prompt.intro:
O Player {player_id} mo Kheleng ya Theoketso.
O na le dithoto tse dingwe, mosebetsi wa gago ke go theokesa gore tolompega ya dithoto tsa gago e oketse.
Dithoto le dintho tse di kwagalelang tsa gago tse o di nang le tona di:
	+ {resource_value_list}
Ka ngwaga le ngwaga, o ka kgobelela mmogo le yo o emegelang le go etsela tsebe ya pheto.
Sebetsa le difeo tse di kgethegileng tsa matshelo:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': Go amogela tsebe e e tseneletseng.
  - '[Deny]': Go tlogela tsebe e e tseneletseng (sebaka).
Khelo e tla sala ka {max_turns} diphofo go feta.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Sebapadi se ile sa leka go amogela phapano ka ntle le gore se be le methopo e nyakegago.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Setsebi sa mabapi. Kolone {col} e kantle ga mabapi.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Setsebi sa mabapi. Kolone {col} e fedile.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Sebapadi {player_id} se lekile go dira tefelo ya theko ka ntle ga gore a be le methopo yeo e nyakegago.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Sebapadi {player_id} se dirile tefelo ya go rekiša ka mokgwa wo o fošagetšego.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Sebapadi {player_id} ga se sa dira tefelo e mpsha ya go reka.

offers.reject: Sebapadi {player_id} se ganne go amogela kgopelo ya phapano.
offers.accept: Modjadji {acceptor_id} o amogele kgwele ya kgwebelo go tšwa go Modjadji {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Player {player_id} o etsele tsebe ene ya pheto go Player {opponent_id}: Dithoto tse di oferweng: {offered} -> Dithoto tse di hlatlweng: {requested}

outcome.win: Sebapadi {winner_id} se fentše ka go ba le poelo e kgolo ya boleng bja setoko.
outcome.draw: Phetogo e swanago ya mohola wa dithoto go bapadi ka moka.
